installCommand: set -e; SDK=$HOME/flutter-sdk; [ -x $SDK/bin/flutter ] || git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git $SDK; export PATH=$SDK/bin:$PATH; flutter config --no-analytics --enable-web; flutter pub get
buildCommand: set -e; export PATH=$HOME/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH; flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE=https://fctv33-api.kedidi-anis.workers.dev
